pages.title: Family Simulator Beach Games
pages.creator: CodesXpirit
pages.description: Family Simulator Beach Games sends a family on a snowy beach vacation. Drive to the coast and work through the holiday activities. Prepare breakfast, spend time by the water and build a snowman. The trip also takes you to a hotel and a campsite, where you collect wood for a bonfire. Use WASD to move around on a keyboard and F to interact with the current task.

pages.title: SKYHILL: Escape From the Skyscraper!
pages.creator: Square Dino LLC
pages.description:
SKYHILL: Escape From the Skyscraper! follows Perry, a businessman trapped in a hotel after a biological attack. Start in the penthouse and make your way down through the building. Search for supplies and weapons as you go, and be ready to fight the monsters you encounter.

Food and energy matter as much as equipment. Keep an eye on how much energy you spend and look for food to keep going. Each part of the descent asks you to balance getting farther down with finding enough supplies to survive.

pages.title: Arrow Sorting
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Arrow Sorting challenges you to untangle chains of fruit by tapping arrows. Each move changes the layout, so look at which path an arrow can open before you choose it. Keep working through the fruit until the board is clear. Later puzzles introduce more involved patterns, and you can unlock skins and visual themes as you play.

pages.title: Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Max Crusher 2 - Destruction, Drift, and Racing! brings together three kinds of driving challenges. Take a car into a crash test to see what happens on impact, practice holding a drift through a turn, or switch to racing when speed is the goal. Drive with WASD, use Space for the handbrake, and press R to flip the car back over. C changes the camera.

pages.title: Screw Match
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Screw Match is a sorting puzzle where you send colored screws to matching glass nut boxes. Check which box a screw can go into before you select it. As the colors and layouts become more complicated, the order you choose matters more. Work through the remaining screws to clear the level.

pages.title: Brain Draw Line
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Brain Draw Line gives you an outline to complete in one continuous stroke. Trace the figure without lifting your finger or releasing the mouse, and avoid retracing the same line. Look over the whole shape before you begin, especially where the paths branch. The puzzles have no timer, so you can plan your route before making the first move.

pages.title: Ball Sort: Color Puzzle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Ball Sort: Color Puzzle gives you a set of flasks with colored balls mixed inside. Transfer balls between the flasks until the colors are separated. Think about which flask can hold a ball temporarily while you get to one below it. Finish sorting the current layout to move on to a more challenging arrangement.

pages.title: Swat Force Vs Terrorists
pages.creator: wavegame
pages.description: Swat Force Vs Terrorists puts you in the role of a SWAT officer in an urban shooter. Look around with the mouse and watch for enemies as you move through the city environments. Check the surroundings for threats before lining up a shot, especially when buildings and corners limit what you can see.

pages.title: Cop Run 3d
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Cop Run 3d puts a police officer on a parkour route through city streets. Time your jumps to get over fences and keep away from spikes as you run. Pick up coins and other rewards along the way. Watch the next obstacle before you commit to a jump so you can keep moving through the chase.

pages.title: Puzzle Blocks Classic
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Puzzle Blocks Classic gives you shapes to drag onto a grid. Complete lines to clear space and score, and look for chances to trigger Super Blocks that can remove several lines at once. If space gets tight, a booster can help you continue. You get three chances to clear the center, so consider how much room a move will leave for the next piece. See how far your score takes you on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Madness Cars Destroy
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description:
Madness Cars Destroy turns driving into six arena challenges. In Funnel, push other cars off the edge as the floor narrows. In Rotating Cube, stay on top while the surface spins faster. Deadly Arena adds falling bombs and collapsing sections, and lets you shoot back.

Dodge spinning mines in Deadly Bouncers, take on the color challenge in Right Color, or pass the bomb before it goes off in Hot Potato. Pick from Russian and foreign cars before heading into the arena.

pages.title: 3 Tiles
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: 3 Tiles starts with layers of illustrated tiles. Select exposed tiles to move them into a tray with seven slots. Three tiles with the same picture disappear and earn points, and successive matches can build a combo. Watch which pictures are still covered before you choose, since clearing a top layer opens up more options underneath. Remove every tile to finish the stage.

pages.title: Canasta Royale Offline
pages.creator: MINDWAYTECH CONSULTING SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
pages.description: Canasta Royale Offline lets you play Canasta with two or four players. Build melds using cards from two standard decks and four jokers. Twos and jokers are wild, so you can use them alongside matching ranks. Set the direction of play to clockwise or counterclockwise. The game saves after each turn and includes an undo option if you make a mistaken meld.

pages.title: Magnet Truck
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Magnet Truck puts a huge magnet on your vehicle so you can pull metal out of rocks and the ground. Drive where you can reach material and use the magnet to extract it. Improve your equipment to go after more valuable metals. The more capable the truck becomes, the more kinds of material you can collect.

pages.title: Stick Archer Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Stick Archer Online pits your stick figure against other archers. Move sideways to line up shots or dodge incoming arrows. Earn coins by completing levels and use them to improve your equipment. Choose bows, arrows, quivers and shields, and unlock talents and effects that give you more options for later duels.

You can also customize the archer with hats, masks, hair and animations, or add stickers to your flag.

pages.title: Rooftop Challenge
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Rooftop Challenge starts at street level and asks you to find the house that opens the route upward. Once you find it, climb from roof to roof and cross gaps between buildings. Narrow ledges leave little room to adjust, so look ahead before committing to a jump. Keep finding a route through the city as the climbs get higher.

pages.title: 2248 Block Merge
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: 2248 Block Merge is a number puzzle about connecting tiles to make larger values. Link tiles to double the number, then look at how the new value fits with the tiles still on the board. Keep building connections as long as you can. The aim is to make the highest number your chain of merges can reach.

pages.title: Russian Cargo Simulator
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Russian Cargo Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a cargo truck making deliveries across Russia. Guide the truck over challenging terrain and get its load to the destination. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive and Space to brake. Change the view with C if you want a different angle on the route, or press R to reset.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Attack
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Skibidi Toilet Attack is a shooter that sends waves of enemies at you across a series of levels. Aim at the enemies as they approach and try to survive long enough to get through the wave. Keep checking where the next attack is coming from while you deal with the threats already in front of you.

pages.title: Rude Races
pages.creator: FK
pages.description: Rude Races is a combat racer where you can fight opponents while trying to outrun them. Steer with A and D or the left and right arrows, and press Space to swing your weapon. Take on missions with different enemies and difficulty levels, then edit the parts on your ATV between runs. On the course, decide when to focus on speed and when to strike a nearby rival.

pages.title: Runner Coaster
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Runner Coaster puts you in control of a roller coaster on a route full of obstacles. Press and hold to move, and time when you advance so the cars can get past the hazards. Pick up the people along the way to bring them along for the ride. Keep the coaster moving through the course as more passengers join.

pages.title: Builder Idle Arcade
pages.creator: Lipsar Studio LLC
pages.description: Builder Idle Arcade turns house construction into a series of orders. Buy processing machines to turn resources into building materials, then upgrade them to get more from your operation. Use the supplies to finish the current house. Each completed order leads to a more involved project and gives your builder new skills to work more efficiently.

pages.title: Corn Hole 3D
pages.creator: RoshanGames
pages.description: Corn Hole 3D brings the lawn game to a virtual board. Take turns tossing bags toward the far end. A bag through the hole is worth three points, while one that stays on the board earns one. The scores from opposing throws cancel against each other, so getting a bag onto the board can matter even when you miss the hole. Reach at least 21 points to win.

pages.title: Super Hoops Basketball
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Super Hoops Basketball is a puzzle about rolling a basketball into a hoop. Turn the platforms to guide the ball, and try to collect the stars on its way down. A platform turned too far can send the ball off course and end the attempt. Make small adjustments as it reaches each new surface.

pages.title: Noob Rush vs Pro Monsters
pages.creator: KukoGames
pages.description: Noob Rush vs Pro Monsters sends a running character through attacks from the ground and the air. Watch the monsters as they approach and avoid the objects they throw. Use the arrow keys or WASD to move and Space to jump. If you are using the on-screen buttons, you can move and shoot as you try to stay alive.

pages.title: Bubble Tanks 3
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description:
Bubble Tanks 3 puts you in a bubble tank that travels between connected bubble fields. Fight other tanks and gather the bubbles they leave behind so yours can grow. As you explore farther from the start, you can choose when to face tougher opponents. Develop your tank and try different builds as you find new areas.

Use WASD to move with the default keys, or change the bindings in Settings. Press P during a fight to pause and see the arena options.

pages.title: Hero Attack
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Hero Attack turns your hero into a projectile. Pull back and launch the character toward the enemies, aiming to take out every target in the stage. Some barriers can be broken, while others are better avoided, so choose an angle that takes the layout into account. There are 45 levels, with a leaderboard for your results.

pages.title: Hero 5 Katana Slice
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Hero 5 Katana Slice puts you in the role of a swordsman defending his family and hometown from a rival clan. Use the katana against samurai who close in and deal with armored fighters who are harder to bring down. Rooftop ninjas throw shurikens from a distance, so use a ranged throw to reach them. Clear the attackers threatening your home.

pages.title: Wake up Buddy
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Wake up Buddy challenges you to rouse a friend who is sleeping through everything. Use the objects and weapons in the room, including a grenade, to disturb the sleeper. Upgrade the equipment or its power when your attempts fall short, and change parts of the interior as you work on waking him.

pages.title: Slidey Block Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Slidey Block Puzzle gives you a board of horizontal blocks that you can slide left or right. Move a block to close a gap and fill a row, then clear the row to make more room. Look at which gaps each block can reach before you move it. You can also switch between two visual styles.

pages.title: Flying Mufic
pages.creator: Raguron IT
pages.description: Flying Mufic challenges you to stay in the air and get past obstacles. Press the screen to flap, holding longer when you need to climb higher. Watch the height of the next barrier and adjust your press to find a path past it. See how high a score you can reach before the flight ends.

pages.title: Steve AdventureCraft Nether
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Steve AdventureCraft Nether sends Steve through ten levels filled with zombies, flying creatures and other monsters. Gather the friendly animals you meet and hunt the hostile creatures that block your way. Keep track of which creatures you are approaching as you move through each stage, and work your way through the Nether to the final level.

pages.title: Bricks & Blocks
pages.creator: gameshub
pages.description: Bricks & Blocks gives you brick shapes to fit into an open grid. Drag a piece into empty cells and complete a row or column to clear space. Look at the gaps you will leave after each placement, because the next shape may need room across several cells. The game ends when you have nowhere to put another piece.

pages.title: Neon Way
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Neon Way asks you to guide a moving character along a neon route. Tap to steer around the walls and pass through the diamonds to collect them. The route speeds up as you play, leaving less time to make the next adjustment. See how many diamonds you can gather before hitting a wall.

pages.title: Babel Tower
pages.creator: Airapport
pages.description:
Babel Tower is an idle building game about raising the Tower of Babel one floor at a time. Start by mining stone, then get bricks to the upper floors with a crane. As the tower rises, new equipment opens up. A lumbermill turns logs into planks, and a drummer can speed up the workers carrying materials.

Later, use a well and pump to help the forest elephant keep hauling larger loads. Expand production and transport together so the builders have supplies for the next floor.

pages.title: Gold Fish Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Gold Fish Jigsaw Puzzle gives you pictures to rebuild from scattered pieces. Choose a difficulty, then look for fragments that go together. Start with details you can recognize, such as part of a fish or a clear edge in the picture, and work outward from there until the image is complete.

pages.title: Swinging Bee
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Swinging Bee sends a bee flying past flowers and trees. Tap the screen to flap and adjust its path whenever an obstacle gets close. Watch the gaps ahead and time the next tap to keep the bee from crashing. The aim is to guide it safely through the route to its destination.

pages.title: Control 4 Cars
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Control 4 Cars asks you to switch lanes for four cars at once. Click a car's control area or use S, D, K and L to move the corresponding vehicle. Pick up the scoring items and steer clear of hazards while watching all four routes. One crash ends the whole run, so keep checking the other cars after each lane change.

pages.title: Top Speed Highway Car Racing Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Top Speed Highway Car Racing Game puts you behind the wheel on a highway full of traffic. Steer around vehicles as you build speed, and judge whether there is enough space before changing lanes. Going faster leaves less time to react to the cars ahead, so watch for an opening before you boost.

pages.title: Choly Food Drop
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Choly Food Drop puts you in control of a flightless chicken trying to catch a meal. Walk under the food falling from above and pick up as much as you can. Some of the falling objects are hazards. Move aside before one hits you, because a collision with a hazard ends the run.

pages.title: Supercars Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Supercars Jigsaw breaks pictures of sports cars into pieces and gives you a layout to rebuild them on. Move each piece to its place until the full car picture comes together. Use the outline of a wheel or the curve of the bodywork to decide where a fragment belongs when you have several similar pieces.

pages.title: Color Zig Zag
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Color Zig Zag sends you along a winding course made of colored blocks. Use the mouse to change direction as you reach a bend, and pay attention to the colors along the route. Collect coins on the way and try to keep moving through the turns long enough to improve your score.

pages.title: Crush the Smiles
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Crush the Smiles sends smiley faces falling down the screen. Click them before they get away, but leave the red faces alone. A missed smile costs you points, so be quick without clicking everything in sight. The run ends if you click three red smiles. Watch the colors as the next batch starts falling.

pages.title: Super Footpool
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Super Footpool combines soccer with the aiming of a pool game. Set the angle and power of a shot and try to put the ball in the goal. The computer opponent is also trying to score, so be ready to line up a kick quickly when you have an opening. Win matches as you play toward the World Cup.

pages.title: Christmas Maze
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Christmas Maze asks you to guide a gift box through a maze to the green target. Follow the passages carefully and watch the walls when you turn a corner. A clear route may take you around several bends before you reach the other box. Get there to open the next maze.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Reindeer Surprise
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Reindeer Surprise follows Hazel as she looks after a young reindeer Santa has left with her. Help her feed it and keep it happy by playing games together. Work through the animal care activities as Hazel gets used to having the reindeer around and prepares for Santa to return.

pages.title: Police Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Police Cars Jigsaw lets you pick one of twelve police car pictures to rebuild. Choose an easy puzzle with 25 pieces, a medium one with 49, or a hard one with 100. Match details such as a wheel, roof light or part of the background to find where a piece belongs.

pages.title: Limousine Driver
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Limousine Driver puts you behind the wheel of a limousine on passenger routes. Drive with WASD and make your way along the roads to the stops where passengers are waiting. Allow room for the long car when you take a corner, then continue toward the marked destination to finish the level.

pages.title: Cute Fish Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cute Fish Memory Challenge gives you pictures of fish to match in pairs. Reveal pictures and remember where you saw each one so you can return to it when its match appears. Find every pair to clear the level. There is no timer, so you can take your time recalling the positions.

pages.title: Sentry Guardian
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Sentry Guardian casts you as a gate defender facing an advancing army of demons. Fight back to keep the attackers from getting through, then upgrade your skills to strengthen your defense. Watch the next group as it approaches and use what you have learned from the earlier attacks to hold the gate.

pages.title: Biggy Way
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Biggy Way puts you behind the wheel of a monster truck on an obstacle course. Drive over the hurdles and keep going until you reach the destination. Pay attention to the ground in front of the truck, especially when one obstacle leads straight into the next. Each course asks you to get the truck across the obstacles in your path.

pages.title: Exotic Animals Puzzle Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Exotic Animals Puzzle Time lets you rebuild pictures of exotic animals from scattered pieces. Choose an easy, medium or hard puzzle, then find where the fragments fit. Look for a distinctive patch of color or the outline of the animal to work out which pieces belong together. Complete the picture to solve the puzzle.

pages.title: Monster Machines Shooter
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Monster Machines Shooter gives you bubbles marked with pictures of monster machines. Aim and launch each bubble at a group with the same picture. Connect three or more of a kind to clear them and earn points. Look at the picture on the bubble you are about to shoot, then find a place where it can extend a matching group.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Tongue Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl Tongue Doctor puts you in charge of a cartoon clinic visit. Use the game's tools to help Dotted Girl with her swollen tongue, then check her teeth. Work through the cleaning activities and fit her with braces as the game guides you from the first treatment to the end of her appointment.

pages.title: Mortar.io
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Mortar.io puts you in a battle arena with a mortar as your only weapon. Aim ahead of a moving opponent so the shot lands where they are going. A hit takes prediction as well as aim because the shell needs time to reach its target. Defeat opponents to unlock more powerful mortars.

pages.title: Draw Here 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Draw Here 2 asks you to collect stars by drawing lines and shapes. Make your drawing inside the designated box, then see whether it reaches the stars in the puzzle. If your first idea misses one, try a different shape or placement. The challenge is to use the drawing area to reach every star.

pages.title: The Dino King
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: The Dino King is an endless runner where a dinosaur has to keep going past a stream of obstacles. Jump as a barrier comes within reach and collect coins along the route. Watch for the next obstacle as soon as you land so you can time another jump. Keep running to improve your score.

pages.title: Umbrella Down 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Umbrella Down 2 sends an umbrella carrier down through a shaft full of moving hazards. Use the umbrella to adjust the descent as you approach gears and other obstacles. Watch for a clear opening before you drop farther. Keep finding a way between the hazards and see how far down you can get.

pages.title: Battlestar Mazay
pages.creator: Rumata Lab
pages.description: Battlestar Mazay puts Mazay in command of a star cruiser in a 2D space shooter. Pilot the cruiser and fire back while moving out of the path of incoming rockets and shots. Watch for bosses with their own health bars, and keep the cruiser moving while you look for an opening to attack.

pages.title: Candy Land
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Candy Land is a puzzle about clearing sweets and creating special pieces. Work with the candies on the board to make striped candies, wrapped candies and rainbow candies. Pay attention to which groups you can clear and what the board will look like afterward, so you can set up another special sweet.

pages.title: Jump In The Circle
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Jump In The Circle asks you to keep a character moving around a circular arena. Tap to jump when a hazard comes up on the route, then get ready for the next one as you land. Staying in play builds your score, and the gems you collect can be spent on new skins.

pages.title: FUNNY BUNNY LOGIC
pages.creator: 7thReactor
pages.description: FUNNY BUNNY LOGIC asks you to turn the tiles on a board green so a bunny can cross. Tap the tiles and check what changes after each move. The goal is to make the whole board green at once, so look at the remaining tiles together as you decide where to tap next.

pages.title: MR JUMP HUSKY
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: MR JUMP HUSKY follows a dog running in search of bones. Time your jumps to get the husky across the obstacles in each course and collect the bones along the way. The routes span five worlds with about 80 levels in total. Keep an eye on what comes after each jump so you are ready for the next one.

pages.title: MiniPool.io
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: MiniPool.io lets you play billiards against other players or practice on your own. Aim the cue, set the strength and choose where to strike the cue ball to put spin on it. In VS Player mode, the game pairs you with someone at a similar level. In Only mode, practice your aim before the time runs out. Choose an avatar and customize your cue or table before you play.

pages.title: Unreal Race
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Unreal Race puts you on a scrolling road with other cars moving through the lanes. Steer left or right to get around traffic and pick up coins when the road is clear. The traffic comes faster as the run continues, leaving less time to choose a direction. Keep avoiding collisions to improve your best score.

pages.title: Beach Restaurant
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Beach Restaurant gives you a kitchen and customers waiting for their food. Look at the orders as they come in, cook what each customer asks for and serve the dishes. The challenge is to keep up while preparing the right food, especially when there is more than one order to handle.

pages.title: Wedding Fashion Advisor
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Wedding Fashion Advisor lets you put together outfits for weddings with different themes. Choose clothing for Indian, Chinese and African wedding events, using the wardrobe options provided for each one. Try different combinations within the event's style and see how the pieces look together before settling on a finished outfit.

pages.title: Truck Physics
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Truck Physics is a cargo puzzle where you prepare a truck for a mountain delivery. Use the mouse to arrange the load, keeping junk off the truck and trying to get the cargo into place. Change the traffic light to send the truck on its way. The challenge is to load it so the cargo can reach the end of the course.

pages.title: Crazy Balls
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Crazy Balls gives you a batch of bouncing balls and a field of numbered shapes. Hold, drag and release to set the direction of your throw. Each hit lowers a shape's number, and reaching zero breaks it. Aim where the balls can rebound into several shapes in one turn. Keep clearing shapes to raise your score in the endless mode.

pages.title: Falling Boxes
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Falling Boxes is a timing game about dropping boxes onto a stack. Tap to let the next box fall and try to land it on the ones below. A successful drop adds to your score and lets you build higher. Watch the box's position before releasing it, because a box that falls out of the play area ends the run.

pages.title: Wedding Planner
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Wedding Planner lets you decorate two possible venues for a couple's wedding. Work with the planner to try a design at each location, then compare how the two spaces look once they are ready. When the decorating is finished, pick the venue where you want the couple to hold the ceremony.

pages.title: Guess the Superhero
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guess the Superhero shows you an abstract picture and asks you to work out the character it represents. Look for colors, shapes or symbols that point to a superhero, then enter the letters of the name. Correct answers earn coins. If you get stuck on a later picture, spend some of those coins to reveal a hint.

pages.title: Street Fight
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Street Fight pits you against street thugs with different fighting styles. Use five attack combinations to knock them out and earn coins from your wins. Spend those coins on power-ups in the shop.

The game has ten enemy types and three maps: Sunset Avenue, Frozen Overpass and Mean Street. Pay attention to how each opponent fights as you decide which combination to use.

pages.title: Touchdown Rush
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Touchdown Rush puts you on an American football field with defenders between you and the end zone. Run past them and collect bonuses or power-ups as you go. Watch for a gap before changing direction, then keep moving downfield. The goal is to make it through the defense and score a touchdown.

pages.title: Trick Hoops
pages.creator: WITCHHUT LLC
pages.description: Trick Hoops asks you to make basketball shots through layouts full of obstacles. Choose a player, then aim so the ball reaches the basket and picks up the star on the way. Some shots need a different arc to get around what stands in front of the hoop. Solve the stages to unlock bonus puzzles.

pages.title: Smiley Ball
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Smiley Ball is a platform game where you roll a smiling ball through levels filled with obstacles. Move left or right and jump over hazards to keep going. Pick up stars as you make your way through the stage, then reach the end to move on. The level selector lets you return to earlier courses.

pages.title: 4 Images and 1 Word
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: 4 Images and 1 Word gives you four pictures with one word in common. Look across all four for a shared object, idea or action, then enter the word that fits. If a guess only makes sense for one picture, check the others for a clue that ties the whole set together.

pages.title: Coloring Cars Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Coloring Cars Time lets you choose a car picture and color it your way. Pick a color and apply it to the parts of the drawing you want to change. Try one shade for the body and another for the smaller details, or use a matching palette across the whole picture.

pages.title: 3 Point Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: 3 Point Rush turns basketball shooting into a swipe challenge. Flick the ball toward the hoop and adjust the direction of your next swipe based on where the last shot went. Choose a ball and a game mode before you play. The aim is to sink as many baskets as you can and improve your score.

pages.title: Terror of Deep Sand
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Terror of Deep Sand puts you in control of a giant worm hiding under a desert. Move through the sand and attack the army that has come to hunt you. Try to take out as many enemies as you can to raise your score. You can buy stronger worms for later attempts.

pages.title: Dynamons
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Dynamons is the first game in the creature-collecting RPG series. Collect creatures and train them for battles, then use your roster to take on other Dynamons. Developing different creatures gives you more choices about which one to bring into combat. Keep training your team as you work through the encounters.

pages.title: Princess Eskimo
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Eskimo gives Elsa, Rapunzel, Moana and Cinderella winter wardrobes for the first snowy day. Dress each character with items such as faux-fur coats, knitted ponchos, dresses or leggings. Add tall boots, a fur hat or mittens to finish the outfit. Try a different mix of knitwear and accessories for each princess.

pages.title: Princess Beauty Salon
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Beauty Salon takes a princess through a makeup and manicure session. Try different makeup styles and settle on the look you want before moving on to her hands. Choose a nail color to go with the makeup, or make it stand out with a different shade. Finish both stages to complete the makeover.

pages.title: Flower Spring Ball
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Flower Spring Ball follows Sarah as she gets ready for a spring dance. Start with her makeup and choose eyeshadow and lipstick, then move on to her hair and outfit. Try colors together as you work through the choices so the makeup, hairstyle and clothes suit the look you want for the ball.

pages.title: Mole: the first scavenger
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Mole: the first scavenger sends a mole through a series of routes with food scattered along the way. Use the arrow keys to change direction, and guide the mole toward food as you work out how to reach the destination. Look at what is on each route before turning so you can pick up more food on the way.

pages.title: Princess Bridal Shower Party
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess Bridal Shower Party has a group of princesses throwing a shower for their friend before her wedding. Make the invitation, then decorate the room with balloons, cake and presents. Once the party space is ready, help the princesses choose dresses for the celebration. The preparations cover both the room and what everyone will wear.
